title: Affine-base quasi-compact lift of an arbitrary fibre open
statement: Let $h:Y\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and of finite presentation, meaning locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Suppose every scheme-theoretic fibre $Y_t$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically reduced over its residue field $\kappa(t)$ [def-weil-residue-field, def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Let $s\in S$ and let $T\subseteq Y_s$ be any open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion], possibly empty or disconnected. There exist an affine open neighbourhood $S_0\subseteq S$ of $s$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and a quasi-compact open subscheme $W\subseteq Y\times_S S_0$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] such that $W\to S_0$ is flat and of finite presentation with geometrically reduced fibres, and $W_s=T$ as open subschemes of $Y_s$, under the canonical identification $(Y\times_S S_0)_s=Y_s$.

source.place: Tag 055W, label lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, proof, first paragraph: affine localization, lifting the whole prescribed fibre open and verifying the restricted family hypotheses (old item steps 1–3)

proof.text: Choose an affine open neighbourhood S₀ of s using exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset. Its open subscheme is affine, hence compact and quasi-separated. Put X = Y ×[S] S₀. The second projection is flat, locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated by base change. In particular X is quasi-separated.

source.place: Tag 055W, label lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, proof, first paragraph: affine localization, lifting the whole prescribed fibre open and verifying the restricted family hypotheses (old item steps 1–3)

proof.text: The morphism h.fiberToSpecResidueField s is locally of finite type, since local finite presentation implies local finite type and is stable under base change. Its target is the spectrum of a field and is locally Noetherian, so the fibre is locally Noetherian. The inclusion of T is therefore quasi-compact. The fibre is compact by quasi-compactness of h and base change, hence T is compact as well.

source.place: Tag 055W, label lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, proof, first paragraph: affine localization, lifting the whole prescribed fibre open and verifying the restricted family hypotheses (old item steps 1–3)

proof.text: The fibre inclusion is a topological embedding, so T is the inverse image of an ambient open O in Y. Intersect O with h⁻¹(S₀); this still contains the image of T because all its points lie over s. The image of T is compact. At each of its points choose an affine open contained in this intersection. A finite subcover yields a compact open U in Y contained in h⁻¹(S₀). The two containments give (h.fiberι s)⁻¹(U) = T. This is the proved private helper exists_compact_open_between, applied to the image of T. Empty T is handled by the same finite-subcover argument.

source.place: Tag 055W, label lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, proof, first paragraph: affine localization, lifting the whole prescribed fibre open and verifying the restricted family hypotheses (old item steps 1–3)

proof.text: Let W = (pullback.fst h S₀.ι)⁻¹(U). The first projection is an open immersion with image h⁻¹(S₀). Since U is contained in this image, its inverse image W is compact, by the inducing-map compactness criterion. The image of W in Y is exactly U (image of a preimage contained in the range); thus the required equality of opens follows from (h.fiberι s)⁻¹(U) = T. This constructs the open inside the prescribed pullback without choosing a fibre identification.

source.place: Tag 055W, label lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, proof, first paragraph: affine localization, lifting the whole prescribed fibre open and verifying the restricted family hypotheses (old item steps 1–3)

proof.text: The composite W → X → S₀ is flat and locally of finite presentation because these properties hold for the base-changed family and for the open immersion W → X, and are stable under composition. X is quasi-separated by step 1, so W is quasi-separated: the open embedding sends compact open subsets and their intersections to the corresponding subsets of X. The permanence results then make W → S₀ quasi-separated, and make it quasi-compact since W is compact and S₀ is quasi-separated. These are exactly the required finite-presentation properties.

source.place: Tag 055W, label lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, proof, first paragraph: affine localization, lifting the whole prescribed fibre open and verifying the restricted family hypotheses (old item steps 1–3)

proof.text: Convert the assumed geometric reducedness of all fibres into geometric reducedness of h by geometrically_iff_forall_fiberToSpecResidueField. It persists under base change to X → S₀. To see that restriction to W preserves it, base change to any field. The pullback for W → S₀ maps by an open immersion into the reduced pullback for X → S₀ (the square is a pullback, by pasting the two defining pullback squares). An open subscheme of a reduced scheme is reduced. This is the proved private helper geometricallyReduced_comp_open. Hence W → S₀ is geometrically reduced and therefore all its fibres are geometrically reduced. This includes empty W and empty fibres.

proof_origin.place: Tag 055W, lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced, first paragraph; the Lean proof lifts a compact fibre open in Y inside h⁻¹(S₀), then pulls it back to Y ×[S] S₀. reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q02-024fcdb42 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item (6 steps, no new nodes, statement unchanged) against the first paragraph of Stacks more-morphisms 055W (lemma-fibre-geometrically-connected-reduced) and against every cited statement. Step 1: the affine S_0 comes from affine-opens-basis; flatness and finite presentation of h_0 come from qcqs-permanence (3) and flat base change; X is qcqs by permanence (2); X_t = Y_t because Spec κ(t)→S factors through the open S_0. Step 2: the fibre over the field is locally of finite type, hence locally Noetherian by pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft, and quasi-compact. The inclusion T→F is quasi-compact by lem-sfb-noetherian-open-immersion-qc, so T is quasi-compact. This is the fact 055W leaves implicit. Step 3: by def-pc-scheme-fibre (01K1), |F| has the subspace topology. A finite affine subcover inside the open O gives W, and lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product gives W_s = T as open subschemes. Step 4: W→S_0 is flat because the stalks are those of X. It is locally of finite presentation by applying lem-weil-pbc-lfp-affine-opens-finite-presentation to affine opens of X. Step 5: W is quasi-separated by both directions of the affine-cover criterion, using only that X is quasi-separated and never that the intersections are affine. Permanence (1) then gives finite presentation. Step 6: being open in a reduced scheme after every field extension gives geometrically reduced fibres. proof_deps equals the union of the step uses. Every cited statement node is a Mathlib leaf, so there are no route or tool_uses issues. I checked the edge cases: empty T, disconnected T, non-closed s, non-quasi-separated S and non-separated Y. A grep for duplicates over 055W and 01K1 citers found no existing node with this statement. The parent's step 1 uses exactly these conclusions. No SGA source is cited. Only cosmetic point: the report names a citations.json that is not in the commit.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affine_neighbourhood_quasiCompact_open_of_fiber_open {Y S : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ S) [Flat h] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation h] [QuasiCompact h] [QuasiSeparated h] (hred : ∀ t : S, GeometricallyReduced (h.fiberToSpecResidueField t)) (s : S) (T : (h.fiber s).Opens) : ∃ S₀ : S.Opens, s ∈ S₀ ∧ IsAffineOpen S₀ ∧ ∃ W : (pullback h S₀.ι).Opens, CompactSpace W ∧ Flat (W.ι ≫ pullback.snd h S₀.ι) ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation (W.ι ≫ pullback.snd h S₀.ι) ∧ QuasiCompact (W.ι ≫ pullback.snd h S₀.ι) ∧ QuasiSeparated (W.ι ≫ pullback.snd h S₀.ι) ∧ (∀ t : S₀, GeometricallyReduced ((W.ι ≫ pullback.snd h S₀.ι).fiberToSpecResidueField t)) ∧ (h.fiberι s) ⁻¹ᵁ (W.ι ≫ pullback.fst h S₀.ι).opensRange = T
